In 2024, we—Max Schweder @drzerschwederer and Dr. Tobias Hartmann @tob_har, collaborating as CYLVESTER @cylvester_band —were honored to contribute to the Kulturkonferenz Ruhr, themed “KI: Muse oder Monster?” Our project, “Prompting for Paradise“, produced by SAVE THE WORLD @savetheworld_e.v._ featured an AI-driven chatbot that conducted a real-time interview with North Rhine-Westphalia’s Minister for Culture and Science, Ina Brandes. Additionally, we developed another bot to engage conference attendees in conversations, collecting diverse perspectives on AI’s role in culture. The insights gathered culminated in a final audio-visual performance, artistically reflecting the dialogues between humans and machines; realtime visuals by Max Schweder, mashing up the graphical data collected by the ai chat bots and featuring Ai generated and manually remixed music by CYLVESTER. 

We are so thankful to all who entrusted us with this opportunity.

Realtime N-body Universe Simulation Hack

4.000.000 bodies attracting each other. 
I love that when hundreds of thousands of them come too close together, they explode in interesting ways. Sometimes you can even see Jetstreams. 

This is my 10th attempt at this. It’s suuuper hacky. I’m using gradients and blurs of clustered objects to calculate the attraction forces. But it’s getting closer and closer to looking really cool. :) and it’s running in realtime with @touchdesigner.
